header: L3 · The maintainer three years from now · sonnet
verdict: The round-9 findings with status A or M read as resolved at the baseline. The delta adds one Required gap (the plan has no task that writes the base-defined pr job) and two Advisory ones.

findings.defect: The G5 fix makes the pr job a base-defined pull_request_target workflow file that 10 10.2 checks row by row, but no plan task writes that file, and T005 (the pr step, 'lands whole') still lists only the `checks` surface although it adds tools/ci/askfirst.go and a workflow, which now belong to `approvals`.
findings.scenario: T005 lands the pr step with a pull_request workflow or none; the job that judges every later pull request is not the one the spec describes, and nothing in the plan owns the move. The Ask-first forecast of T005 omits `approvals`, so the maintainer gives no approval early.
findings.change: Add the pr job file (permissions, checkout of github.sha, head fetched by head.sha, a fixture per refusal of tools/ci workflows) to T005's acceptance, and set Ask-first to `checks`, `approvals`; list `approvals` in the Ask-first of T002/T004-type tasks that touch .github/workflows.

findings.section: plan T015, T078, pending list (sbxdrv surface)
findings.defect: T015 and T078 depend on 'the sbxdrv surface tooling PR (05 5.3)', which has no task id; it exists only as a bullet of the pending list.
findings.scenario: A dependency check or a new reader of the task graph finds a prerequisite that is not a node; the PR is forgotten or lands after T015.
findings.change: Give it a task id in Phase 0 with its acceptance (the sbxdrv surface and skills/** on kits in .github/ask-first.yaml), and depend on that id.

findings.defect: The new surface id `approvals` reads as the thing every surface line grants ('Approval: approvals - ...'), and one path now sits on up to three surfaces (`approvals`, `checks`, `dependencies`) with no Vocabulary entry.
findings.scenario: A new contributor reads 'approvals' as the generic word, or supplies one line where three are needed.
findings.change: Name the surface for what it holds (for example `gate-code`) or give 05 5.3 one table of path to surfaces that states the overlap.

out_of_scope: Pages 01, 02, 03, 08, 09 and 11 were skimmed through the diff stat only. The rest of the 12 12.4 pr-job text and ADR 0010's amended-record claims were not traced to the older ADRs.
confidence: Medium: the three findings were checked by grep and reading at the baseline; coverage of the large delta is partial.
